notes.title: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered is Available Now!
notes.content:
Play the next series of Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection of the Darkness Trilogy.


[b]Included Game Titles
[/b]
[b]Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation[/b] – Lara Croft discovers the lost tomb of the Egyptian God Set, unwittingly unleashing him and fulfilling an ancient prophecy—one that plunges mankind into darkness.

[b]Tomb Raider: Chronicles[/b] – Following the events of The Last Revelation, Lara Croft is buried in an Egyptian tomb and is presumed dead. At her memorial, those closest to her reminisce about secrets from her past.

[b]Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness[/b] – Accused of murder, Lara becomes a fugitive on the run, while uncovering a sinister conspiracy involving alchemical experiments and the search for ancient artifacts.


[b]Key Features
[/b]
See the Classic & Remastered Visuals: Play with the original polygonal models or swap to the remastered graphics at any time
Travel the Globe: Follow Lara Croft around iconic locales including Cairo, Rome, Paris, and many more
Experience Lara’s Darkest Adventures: Uncover the secrets of Lara Croft’s past and shed light on the mystery of her disappearance

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525380/Tomb_Raider_IVVI_Remastered/]Play Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered now![/url]

notes.title: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered Coming Soon!
notes.content:
One year after the original trilogy, Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered is releasing on February 14th, 2025.

Alongside updated graphics and controls for Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation and Tomb Raider: Chronicles, this collection also features numerous fixes and restorations to Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness, giving players a chance to experience this cult classic as originally envisioned. 

Check out the [url=https://www.tombraider.com/news/video-games/restoring-tomb-raider-the-angel-of-darkness-remastered]official blog[/url] for more information on new areas, Kurtis Trent's restored abilities, and added story depth, and be sure to pre-order Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2525380/Tomb_Raider_IVVI_Remastered/

notes.title: The Official Tomb Raider Gear Store is Live!
notes.content:

notes.title: Lara Croft is Back! Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Out NOW
notes.content:
Tomb Raider I-III Remastered features the original three games, and for the first time available on modern consoles fans can also play: 

[list]
[*] Tomb Raider’s “Unfinished Business” Expansion 
[*] Tomb Raider II’s “The Golden Mask” Expansion 
[*] Tomb Raider III’s “The Lost Artefact” Expansion 
[/list]
[previewyoutube=Q_vH_0gpVlk;full][/previewyoutube]

Tomb Raider I-III Remastered allows fans to toggle between nostalgic 90s graphics and lovingly remastered visuals, and well as classic or modern control schemes. It also includes new features such as photo mode, over 200 trophies, and more.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478970/Tomb_Raider_IIII_Remastered_Starring_Lara_Croft/]Available Now in the Steam Store[/url]

You can learn more in our recent blog: [url=https://www.tombraider.com/news/video-games/everything-you-need-to-know-about-tomb-raider-i-iii-remastered]Everything you need to Know about Tomb Raider I-III Remastered[/url].

notes.title: Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness, the game that almost killed the series
notes.content: From 2010 to 2014 Richard Cobbett wrote Crapshoot, a column about rolling the dice to bring random obscure games back into the light. This week, Lara Croft faces her darkest hour in the platformer that almost killed its creators and put a legend on life support. But was it really that bad? (Yes.).. Read more.
